scientific_integrity.assertion: Complete formal-power-series enumeration for finite labeled alphabets with f>=1 fixed and d>=1 swapped pairs under an involutive antimorphism.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Greedy arch factorization and exact support counts at the symmetry midpoint.
scientific_limitations: The theorem excludes involutions of pure fixed-point or pure paired type, which have known special-case distributions.
It does not address cyclic or unlabeled equivalence classes.
Finite verification is not a replacement for the all-parameter proof.
Originality remains subject to broader unindexed-literature comparison.

title: Exact universality-index enumeration for mixed-involution symmetric words
